findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms force you to wait up to three months to get paid for your completed work, which creates significant cash flow pressure.
Net 90 payment terms mean you will wait up to 90 days to be paid after invoicing, which creates cash flow risks.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope this email finds you well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a couple of adjustments before signing: - Regarding the clause "Invoices are payable Net 90.", waiting up to three months to get paid creates significant cash flow pressure, so I propose changing it to: "Invoices are payable Net 30.". - Regarding the clause "Payment period: Net 90", waiting up to 90 days creates cash flow risks, so I propose changing it to: "Payment period: Net 30". Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to moving forward. Best regards,
